raw_evidence_sections.text: The Master International Management program Curriculum and courses With a Master in International Management at ISM in Germany you can build specifically on your previous international business knowledge, further develop your management and organisational skills and kick-start a leading position in business . In this full-time postgraduate international management program, general management theory, analytics & practice are closely interlinked. In addition to the practice-oriented business management content, you can also choose your own individual focus: weather accounting and finance, marketing or operations management - all the wide range of skills you need as a future organisation manager will be taught in this multi-disciplinary management programme. The integrated practical, real-life case-studies, study excursions and internships at companies offer you extensive opportunities to gain hands-on experience, practice problem-solving, connect with companies and prove yourself in various areas. This massively increases your employability after graduating the Master's in International Management. Basic know-how: Global Business Management, Strategic Management, Leadership Skills. Specific expertise: Controlling & Finance; International Marketing; Operations Management; Managing Consulting Projects.

General Management MBA in Germany The full-time MBA in General Management combines academic excellence with practical business expertise at a private business school specialized in management education. Available as a 60 ECTS or 90 ECTS program, it prepares students for leadership, business management and executive positions in an international business environment. Designed for graduates with at least two years of professional experience, the MBA develops strategic management, leadership, and decision-making skills through a strong combination of theory and real-world business practice. A special highlight is the optional semester abroad in the USA at one of our partner universities - City University of Seattle or Boston University - offering valuable international exposure, intercultural experience, and global networking opportunities. MBA students also benefit from experienced lecturers with extensive industry backgrounds , close connections to companies and alumni, as well as additional options such as the Double Degree in the USA and MBA Plus to further enhance their international qualifications. Logistics and Supply Chain Management Acquire specialist international knowledge in logistics In this globalized world businesses often opt for operation centralization, runing their core functions from a central hub. In this context, logistics, purchasing, procurement and distribution of products or services become essential pillars for sustaining global trade. The MSc Logistics and Supply Chain Management at ISM prepares students for careers in global supply chains, logistics optimization, and strategic operations thanks to a highly practical and international approach to teaching . In the Logistics and Supply Chain Management Master's program you will not only learn about logistics processes, operations research, transportation models and value chains, but you will also be sensitized to current hot topics such as sustainability, smart mobility and large capacity planning . The overarching aim of the postgraduate supply chain management master is to provide graduates with tools and insights on how globalized logistics systems can be set up and sustainably maintained. You will also gain more in-depth knowledge of data-driven subjects such as data science and analytics or international operations management . At the same time, you will dive deeper into management topics like leadership, organizational development or project management. A semester abroad will round up your logistics studies and add that high-value international experience touch. raw_evidence_sections.text: Master of Business Psychology Apply psychological knowledge in a business context The Master of Science in Psychology & Management is a comprehensive program that combines psychological principles with business management practices. During three to four semesters you will be prepare d for roles that require expertise in both psychology and business. In this business psychology degree program, you will be trained in the main professional fields for business psychologists – psychology, mark et analysis , consulting and human resources . In the first semester of the Master's in Business Psychology, you will receive a general and broad education in applied psychology in a business context. In the second semester, you will deepen your expertise in workplace psychology, market and media behavior, and human resources management, while gaining practical research and industry experience through a hands-on project and an internship. In the third semester you will gain international exposure via a semester abroad, and in the fourth semester you will work on your master’s thesis project. Basic know-how: psychology, qualitative research methods Specific expertise: brand psychology, industrial psychology
